films.title: The Ninth Gate
films.summary: A rare book dealer finds himself at the heart of a string of paranormal events when he is hired to find the last two copies of a text, The Nine Gates of the Kingdom of Shadows, capable of summoning the Devil.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE NINTH GATE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ROMAN POLANSKI // 1999</text></svg>

films.title: Elevator to the Gallows
films.summary: A self-assured businessman murders his employer, husband of his mistress, which unintentionally provokes an ill-fated chain of events.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ELEVATOR TO THE GALLOWS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">LOUIS MALLE // 1958</text></svg>

films.title: Alien Resurrection
films.summary: Two hundred years after Lt. Ripley died, a group of scientists clone her, hoping to breed the ultimate weapon. But the new Ripley is full of surprises … as are the new aliens. Ripley must team with a band of smugglers to keep the creatures from reaching Earth.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALIEN RESURRECTION</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">JEAN-PIERRE JEUNET // 1997</text></svg>

films.title: Peppermint Candy
films.summary: In the spring of 1999, a group of old friends gather to celebrate their 20 year reunion. Among the group is Yeong-ho, a cold, unhappy man, whose demeanor puts a damper on the festivities. The seriousness of Yeong-ho's depression becomes apparent when he climbs a railroad bridge and looks like he might jump. At this crucial moment, memories of seven crucial episodes from Yeong-ho's past flood his mind.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PEPPERMINT CANDY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">LEE CHANG-DONG // 2000</text></svg>

films.title: The Tree of Life
films.summary: The impressionistic story of a Texas family in the 1950s. The film follows the life journey of the eldest son, Jack, through the innocence of childhood to his disillusioned adult years as he tries to reconcile a complicated relationship with his father. Jack finds himself a lost soul in the modern world, seeking answers to the origins and meaning of life while questioning the existence of faith.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE TREE OF LIFE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TERRENCE MALICK // 2011</text></svg>

films.title: The Double
films.summary: An awkward office drone becomes increasingly unhinged after a charismatic and confident look-alike takes a job at his workplace and seduces the woman he desires.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE DOUBLE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RICHARD AYOADE // 2014</text></svg>

films.title: Steel Magnolias
films.summary: A young beautician, newly arrived in a small Louisiana town, finds work at the local salon, where a small group of women share a close bond of friendship and welcome her into the fold.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">STEEL MAGNOLIAS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">HERBERT ROSS // 1989</text></svg>

films.title: Rebels of the Neon God
films.summary: In Taipei, four youths face alienation, loneliness, and moments of existential crisis amidst a series of minor crimes.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">REBELS OF THE NEON GOD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">TSAI MING-LIANG // 1994</text></svg>

films.title: Speed Racer
films.summary: Speed Racer is a young and brilliant racing driver. When corruption in the racing leagues costs his brother his life, Speed must team up with the police and the mysterious Racer X to bring an end to the corruption and criminal activities.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SPEED RACER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">LANA WACHOWSKI // 2008</text></svg>

films.title: The Last Boy Scout
films.summary: Somewhere in Los Angeles, the city of broken dreams, a stripper is murdered. Now, the private detective she had hired and her ex-footballer boyfriend are going to find her murderer... if they don't kill each other first. But the more they dig, the deeper they become enmeshed in a web of extortion, blackmail and corrupt politics hidden beneath the surface of professional football.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE LAST BOY SCOUT</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">TONY SCOTT // 1991</text></svg>

films.title: Tony
films.summary: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TONY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MATT JOHNSON // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
films.summary: As bass guitarist for a garage-rock band, Scott Pilgrim has never had trouble getting a girlfriend; usually, the problem is getting rid of them. But when Ramona Flowers skates into his heart, he finds she has the most troublesome baggage of all: an army of ex-boyfriends who will stop at nothing to eliminate him from her list of suitors.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SCOTT PILGRIM VS. THE WORLD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">EDGAR WRIGHT // 2010</text></svg>

films.title: Paprika
films.summary: Dr. Atsuko Chiba is a research psychologist who uses a device called the DC Mini to enter her patients' dreams, wherein she adopts the alter-ego "Paprika". When the device is stolen, she must stop rogue elements from merging the dream and waking worlds.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PAPRIKA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">SATOSHI KON // 2006</text></svg>

films.title: A Better Tomorrow III: Love and Death in Saigon
films.summary: Before the events of A Better Tomorrow (1986), Mark 'Gor' Lee heads to Saigon during the Vietnam War to bring home his uncle and cousin, but his task becomes complicated when a well-known criminal tries to help him.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">A BETTER TOMORROW III: LOVE AND DEATH IN SAIGON</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">TSUI HARK // 1989</text></svg>

films.title: The Incomer
films.summary: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE INCOMER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">LOUIS PAXTON // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Buddy
films.summary: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BUDDY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CASPER KELLY // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: 7 Dogs
films.summary: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">7 DOGS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">ADIL EL ARBI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Great Mouse Detective
films.summary: When the diabolical Professor Ratigan kidnaps London's master toymaker, the brilliant master of disguise Basil of Baker Street and his trusted sidekick Dawson try to elude the ultimate trap and foil the perfect crime.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE GREAT MOUSE DETECTIVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BURNY MATTINSON // 1986</text></svg>

films.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
films.summary: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HA-CHAN, SHAKE YOUR BOOTY!</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">JOSEF KUBOTA WLADYKA // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Sound of Music
films.summary: In the years before World War II, a tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey is hired as a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children and brings a new love of life and music into the home.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE SOUND OF MUSIC</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">ROBERT WISE // 1965</text></svg>

films.title: Avengers: Endgame
films.summary: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">AVENGERS: ENDGAME</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">ANTHONY RUSSO // 2019</text></svg>

films.title: The Warriors
films.summary: Prominent gang leader Cyrus calls a meeting of New York's gangs to set aside their turf wars and take over the city. At the meeting, a rival leader kills Cyrus, but a Coney Island gang called the Warriors is wrongly blamed for Cyrus' death. Before you know it, the cops and every gangbanger in town is hot on the Warriors' trail.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE WARRIORS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">WALTER HILL // 1979</text></svg>

films.title: Return to Silent Hill
films.summary: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill—a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RETURN TO SILENT HILL</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">CHRISTOPHE GANS // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Heart of the Beast
films.summary: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HEART OF THE BEAST</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DAVID AYER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Romancing the Stone
films.summary: Though she can spin wild tales of passionate romance, novelist Joan Wilder has no life of her own. Then one day adventure comes her way in the form of a mysterious package. It turns out that the parcel is the ransom she'll need to free her abducted sister, so Joan flies to South America to hand it over. But she gets on the wrong bus and winds up hopelessly stranded in the jungle.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ROMANCING THE STONE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ROBERT ZEMECKIS // 1984</text></svg>

films.title: Nine to Five
films.summary: Three female employees of a sexist, egotistical, lying, hypocritical bigot find a way to turn the tables on him.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NINE TO FIVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">COLIN HIGGINS // 1980</text></svg>

films.title: The Invite
films.summary: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE INVITE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">OLIVIA WILDE // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Four Adventures of Reinette and Mirabelle
films.summary: Two young girls meet, Reinette from the countryside and Mirabelle from Paris, and decide to take a flat together in Paris where they attend University. Four successive stories about their daily lives illustrate the very different views, characters and relation to the world of these two friends.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FOUR ADVENTURES OF REINETTE AND MIRABELLE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">ÉRIC ROHMER // 1987</text></svg>

films.title: Her Will Be Done
films.summary: Nawojka, 20, dreams of escaping her harsh life working at the family farm. Under the influence of the free-spirited Sandra, Naw experiences trance-like episodes and strange powers, just like her dead mother before her…
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HER WILL BE DONE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JULIA KOWALSKI // 2025</text></svg>

films.title: Day & Night
films.summary: When Day, a sunny fellow, encounters Night, a stranger of distinctly darker moods, sparks fly! Day and Night are frightened and suspicious of each other at first, and quickly get off on the wrong foot. But as they discover each other's unique qualities--and come to realize that each of them offers a different window onto the same world-the friendship helps both to gain a new perspective.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DAY & NIGHT</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TEDDY NEWTON // 2010</text></svg>

films.title: Paint Me a Road Out of Here
films.summary: In 1971, underestimated artist Faith Ringgold made a monumental painting for the women incarcerated at Rikers Island jail called “For the Women’s House.” Fifty years later, artist Mary Baxter, who at the age of twenty-five gave birth in prison, finds herself banding together with an eccentric bunch of activists, politicians, artists, corrections officers, and Faith Ringgold to free the painting with the ultimate goal of freeing the women.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PAINT ME A ROAD OUT OF HERE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CATHERINE GUND // 2024</text></svg>

films.title: The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
films.summary: When a Conservative TV crusader threatens to shut down beloved brothel The Chicken Ranch, proprietress Miss Mona Stangley and her girls won't go down without a fight.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE BEST LITTLE WHOREHOUSE IN TEXAS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">COLIN HIGGINS // 1982</text></svg>

films.title: The Blade
films.summary: Adopted by a renowned swordsmith, a young man discovers that his biological father was killed by a powerful bandit called Lung. Leaving to seek revenge, he runs afoul of vicious desert scum, losing his right arm in the process. After being nursed back to health, he learns to compensate for his loss and returns to confront Lung.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE BLADE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">TSUI HARK // 1995</text></svg>

films.title: The Wedding Banquet
films.summary: Frustrated with his commitment-phobic boyfriend Chris and running out of time, Min makes a proposal: a green-card marriage with their friend Angela in exchange for her partner Lee's expensive IVF. Elopement plans are upended, however, when Min's grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE WEDDING BANQUET</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">ANDREW AHN // 2025</text></svg>

films.title: Electra, My Love
films.summary: It has been fifteen years since the death of her father, Agamemnon, and Elektra still burns with hatred for Aegisztosz, who conspired with Elektra's mother to kill him.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ELECTRA, MY LOVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">MIKLÓS JANCSÓ // 1974</text></svg>

films.title: Never After Dark
films.summary: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NEVER AFTER DARK</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DAVE BOYLE // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Forgotten Island
films.summary: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FORGOTTEN ISLAND</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JANUEL MERCADO // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
films.summary: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER YOUR MOTHER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">BASSAM TARIQ // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Take Me Home
films.summary: Anna (Anna Sargent making her acting debut), a middle-aged Korean adoptee with a cognitive disability, cares for her aging parents in a fragile balance of meeting one another’s needs. Alongside her sister Emily (Ali Ahn) and her father (Victor Slezak), they must confront challenging questions about the future, but Anna remains determined to build a life where all of them can thrive.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TAKE ME HOME</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">LIZ SARGENT // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Tokyo MER: Mobile Emergency Room - The Movie
films.summary: The individuals that comprise the Tokyo MER team rush to on-site disasters and accidents, performing life-saving treatment thanks to the OR equipped within their vehicle. Their one mission is simple: leave no one dead. But conflicts arise when an unprecedented event rocks Yokohama after a bomb explodes in Landmark Tower, leaving thousands fighting to escape. Although the chief doctor Kitami believes they should not wait and presses for a quick dispatch, the more level-headed Chief Kamoi of the elite Yokohama MER thinks otherwise — they need to wait until the area is safe to enter, or they won’t be able to save anyone.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TOKYO MER: MOBILE EMERGENCY ROOM - THE MOVIE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">AYA MATSUKI // 2023</text></svg>

films.title: Iphigenia
films.summary: The Greek army is about to set sail to a great battle, but the winds refuse to blow. Their leader, King Agamemnon, seeks to provide better food, but accidentally slays a sacred deer. His punishment from the gods, the sacrifice of his daughter Iphigenia.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">IPHIGENIA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">MIHALIS KAKOGIANNIS // 1977</text></svg>

films.title: Primetime
films.summary: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PRIMETIME</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">LANCE OPPENHEIM // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Ryuichi Sakamoto: Diaries
films.summary: Ryuichi Sakamoto was an extraordinary musician who passed away in March 2023. He meticulously chronicled his final days in his personal diary. By tracing the last three and a half years through his journal, one can see how he confronted the end of his life and the legacy he sought to leave behind.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RYUICHI SAKAMOTO: DIARIES</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">KENSHO OMORI // 2025</text></svg>

films.title: Daughter's Daughter
films.summary: Jin is in her 60s. Her husband gone, her concern is for daughter Zuer, in New York trying out IVF with her partner Michelle. When Jin receives news that Zuer and Michelle have died in an accident, she heads for NY. There, she has another shock: she has inherited Zuer’s embryo and it’s for her to decide its fate. Meanwhile, going to NY also forces Jin to face Emma, the daughter she gave up for adoption when she was 17.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DAUGHTER'S DAUGHTER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">HUANG XI // 2024</text></svg>

films.title: Time and Tide
films.summary: A streetwise young man becomes a bodyguard to score quick cash. He befriends a disillusioned mercenary determined to begin life anew. They find themselves working together to foil an assassination attempt, but their partnership ultimately can't last.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TIME AND TIDE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">TSUI HARK // 2000</text></svg>

films.title: Unzipped
films.summary: Isaac Mizrahi, one of the most successful designers in high fashion, plans his fall 1994 collection.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">UNZIPPED</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">DOUGLAS KEEVE // 1995</text></svg>

films.title: The Odyssey
films.summary: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE ODYSSEY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">CHRISTOPHER NOLAN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Eddington
films.summary: In May of 2020, a standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbor is pitted against neighbor in Eddington, New Mexico.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">EDDINGTON</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">ARI ASTER // 2025</text></svg>

films.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
films.summary: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.
